name: Dang Vu (Matt)
paragraphs: My first job in software was as a trainee at FPT Software. It was the first time I built real software, and I did it inside a company that was already huge. I was only there a few months, but it was fun. Then I moved on to something new.

Then came Bravebits, working on PageFly, a page builder Shopify merchants use to build their stores. I worked on both the frontend and the backend, and I learned a lot there. It was probably the busiest time of my life, because I was juggling the job while still finishing university.

PageFly was already a big, settled product when I joined. sending.ac was younger. There was some old code, but the product was still growing up, and there was a lot left to build. I built a lot of it, from the first line to the day it went live, and when it broke, I was the one who fixed it.
If you're working on something I could help with, I'd be glad to hear from you.
